name: Unraid-Duplicate-File-Handler
description: A web-based tool designed for Unraid to identify and clean up duplicate files across array disks and/or pools. Compare files by relative path, review keep/delete decisions, and either move or delete them with full progress feedback. Ideal for cleaning up after interrupted Unbalance runs (https://github.com/jbrodriguez/unbalance) or manual copy operations.

paths.name: Mount Path
paths.description: Read/write access to Unraid array or pool disks.

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Required for session security • Use a 32-character hex string (0-9, a-f) • In the Unraid terminal, run: openssl rand -hex 16
